credits.title: MOIRA
credits.overview: After missing her train, a woman returns home to find a presence which shouldn’t be there — and crosses an irreversible line.

credits.title: Minotaur
credits.overview: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

credits.title: The Divine Sarah Bernhardt
credits.overview: 1915, Sarah Bernhardt is the world's first star. Free. Modern. Divine. Eccentric. Visionary... Between legend and fantasy, Sarah Bernhardt tells us the love story that marked her life.

credits.title: The White Crows
credits.overview: Vlad, a young closeted Russian homosexual, returns to his small hometown from Moscow. His brother Liokha has arranged a surprise for him: an evening in the sauna with a female prostitute.

credits.title: Anna
credits.overview: Beneath Anna Poliatova's striking beauty lies a secret that will unleash her indelible strength and skill to become one of the world's most feared government assassins.
